newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Cisco trading lower.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Cisco trading lower.

text.p: Cisco Systems Inc, which declined 1-7/8 points to 49-1/4 during regular trading hours, continued falling after the bell, traders said.
"Looks like Cisco's trading down at 48-1/2," one trader said.
The technology-heavy Nasdaq composite index slipped 5.19 points during regular trading.
But tobacco stocks such as Philip Morris Cos Inc, which declined during regular trading, were either inactive or holding their price after the bell.
"Philip Morris is trading a little bit," but at 111-1/2, which is where it closed, a trader said.
During regular trading hours, Philip Morris dropped 4-3/8.
The New York Stock Exchange said session one volume was 34,100, compared to 54,500 on Thursday. Session two volume was 10,436,596, while on Thursday it was 548,900.
